This app is honestly a total game changer. It's incredibly easy to use, and whenever you have a question or need help, you get fast, top-notch support every time. Things that used to be a hassle to fix are now sorted in no time, and for sizing you can instantly add a size chart plus a size recommender (runs small/true to size, etc.). Way too many features to list, and all in one single app. I've used Kiwi Sizing and BF Size Chart before, but this one is by far the best. Definitely sticking with this app going forward.
